evoxc.formats — explicit, dependency-free tensor-only binary file formats.

Scope is the **tensor half** of the modern checkpoint containers:

* `evoxc.formats.safetensors` — safetensors read (`mmap` zero-copy) and
  canonical write.
* `evoxc.formats.gguf` — GGUF v2/v3 read with metadata, tensor infos and
  block dequantization.

Everything here imports `evoxc.core` plus the standard library and numpy
only, and never traces, compiles, moves data or imports another evoxc
submodule.  A loaded tensor is ordinary host data:
`~evoxc.core.Tensor` wrapping numpy memory on `Device('cpu', 0)`.
Memory-mapped tensors are read-only views (copy explicitly if you need a
writable array).  Tokenizers, chat templates, generation configs and model
semantics are out of scope — those belong to a model-addon distribution.

Public surface (also documented in this directory's `CONTEXT.md`):
`load_safetensors`, `save_safetensors`, `SafetensorsFile`,
`load_gguf`, `GGUFFile`, `TensorInfo`.

## Symbols

- [`GGUFFile`](/api/evoxc/formats/gguffile/) — An open, validated GGUF v2/v3 file (metadata + tensor infos + data).
- [`SafetensorsFile`](/api/evoxc/formats/safetensorsfile/) — An open, validated safetensors file.
- [`TensorInfo`](/api/evoxc/formats/tensorinfo/) — Metadata for one tensor stored in a container file.
- [`load_gguf`](/api/evoxc/formats/load-gguf/) — Open and validate a GGUF v2/v3 file.
- [`load_safetensors`](/api/evoxc/formats/load-safetensors/) — Open and validate a safetensors file.
- [`save_safetensors`](/api/evoxc/formats/save-safetensors/) — Write `tensors` to `path` in canonical safetensors layout.
